title: add_call returns Result<&mut Self, ...> — fluent-with-? is the right pattern
description: JmapRequestBuilder::add_call returns Result<&mut Self, ClientError> rather than &mut Self with a panic, or collecting errors in the builder for deferred checking. This allows callers to use ? to propagate duplicate-call-id errors early (compile-time expressible), avoids a panic in library code, and still enables fluent chaining on the happy path (.expect("r1 must succeed")). A contributor might argue for panic (it's a programmer error) or for deferring error to build() — but detecting at the call site gives the clearest location in backtraces and test output.
